evidence.limits: No whisper.srt yet; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook captions complete, later ones sampled once a second). The identity of the other voice (a phone call with Yotam Bar) comes from the caption and the tag, not from audio. Colour roles (yellow for Matan's questions, cyan for the answers) are inferred from caption colours and the phone-to-ear pose. Sound effects and music not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: A phone call with a club member (a civil engineer made redundant at 31) who says engineering earned him little, and that the club gave him a higher income; the Reel argues a degree is a risky path.
audience: students and young graduates considering a degree; salaried engineers
caption_vs_video_note: Caption title 'תואר זה המסלול המסוכן' fits; the caption tells the full story of Yotam Bar (made redundant at 31, club member, earns 2.5 times an engineer) while the video shows only Matan on a phone call with captions of the two sides. The video's text is a question and answer, not a claim to camera; the shirt reads 'אל תעשו תואר!'.

opening.first_frame: Matan sitting cross-legged on a blue velvet sofa in a high-rise living room, phone held to his ear, a black T-shirt reading 'אל תעשו תואר!'; yellow caption 'כמה עושה מהנדס' and a small club logo at top left.
opening.s0_1: Yellow caption 'כמה עושה מהנדס בניין?' (a question) while he listens or asks on the phone; no cut.
opening.s1_3: Cyan caption '11-12 בטוטאל' appears at about 2.2 s as the answer; he turns to look away from camera.
opening.s3_5: The cyan line holds; at about 4.75 s a yellow caption '9 זה אומר?' (his follow-up).
opening.visual_hook: A man on a sofa with a phone to his ear and a printed anti-degree shirt: a candid phone call.
opening.spoken_hook: Speech starts at 0 s (machine transcript, partly garbled): the question about a civil engineer's pay, then the answer '11, 12' at about 2 to 4 s; matches the captions.
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'כמה עושה מהנדס בניין?' is a self-contained question
opening.works_without_sound: yes: the text carries the dialogue, but the speaker roles rely on colour

visual.subject_placement: Matan centred low in a wide static frame, a lot of room and a window wall behind; he looks off camera while on the phone.
visual.setting: A high-floor apartment lounge with floor-to-ceiling windows, blue velvet sofa and blue shelves
visual.color_contrast: blue sofa and cream wall, warm yellow and cyan captions; the T-shirt slogan in gold
visual.props_and_gestures: A phone held to the ear, a shirt with 'אל תעשו תואר!', relaxed pose with legs crossed; hand gestures from 40 s.
visual.supporting_footage: none until the end card (a logo animation and a collage of event photos)
visual.persistent_branding: Gold club logo at the top left from 0 s to about 75 s; the printed shirt acts as a second brand line
visual.visual_progression: A single wide shot of about 76 s; small changes in pose (he leans, scratches his chin at 21 s, tattoo arm raised at 45 s); at 76.2 s cut to the gold logo and collage end card.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is a frame of the same shot with the cyan caption 'פיטרו אותי'.
visual.ui_interference: Captions at the top at about 13 to 28 percent of the height (partly inside the top 14 to 28 percent area); the logo sits in the top 14 percent.

editing.edit_function: The only visual changes are the captions; they carry the dialogue, mark the speaker by colour and show figures big.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 76s: one uncut take, caption changes every 1 to 3 s
t=76.2s: switch to the end card for about 5.5 s
editing.ending: Matan says thanks ('אלוף', 'תודה רבה מתן' in captions), then a gold logo and a collage with 'כי 1000 יזמים לא טועים!' (76 to 81.7 s).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the numbers (11-12, 8.5, 24,000, x2.5) may invite viewers to check them again; comments show many did dispute them.

sound.delivery: A phone conversation: short questions from Matan and longer answers; loudness is quieter than usual (about -28 to -35 dB in most of the call), consistent with a phone speaker. The transcript confirms speech from 0 s to about 78 s, partly garbled between about 14 and 24 s and at 62 to 74 s.
sound.sync: The caption colour changes where the speaker changes (yellow to cyan); no cuts to follow.

text.colour_coding: Yellow for Matan's lines (questions), cyan for the guest's answers (inferred from the phone-call pose); both with dark outlines.
text.placement: Upper third (about 13 to 28 percent of the frame height), unlike his usual lower-middle captions.
text.style: Bold rounded sans with outline, one to two lines.
text.density_and_read_time: Two to eight words per caption, each on screen 1 to 4 s; easy to read.
text.language: Plain spoken Hebrew with money figures and a personal confession: 'אני בן 31', 'פיטרו אותי', 'זה עצוב להגיד אבל כן'.
text.caption_structure: Long: a headline 'תואר זה המסלול המסוכן' with an exclamation emoji, a share request, a story of Yotam (redundancy at 31, joined the club, earned over 30,000 in 60 days, 2.5 times an engineer), a note that the author has a degree himself, a dream line and the question 'מה דעתכם??'. No hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Numbers with dashes and decimal points ('11-12', '8.5', '5,500-6,000') render in a sensible order within Hebrew captions.

story.setup: Matan asks what a civil engineer earns.
story.stakes: A degree that was meant to guarantee security did not.
story.progression: 11-12 gross, 8.5 net; 'I am 31, they laid me off'; the degree was the hardest thing; first month in the club 5,000, then 5,500-6,000 and 24,000 in the second month; 2.5 times an engineer's pay.
story.payoff: A club member earns 2.5 times a salaried engineer and has 'a second chance at his dreams'.
story.resolution: 'לפחות לדעת שניסית להגשים את החלום' and thanks; end card.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the figures are stated but only by the member, with no document or proof in the video
friction_points: t=6 to 30s: only the same wide shot while the dialogue and captions carry everything - interpretation: low visual change
t=52 to 70s: long moral lines in captions - interpretation: slower and more preachy than the first half
claims about pay are disputed in the comments and no proof is shown

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 43 comments (not representative): many engineers dispute the pay claim ('מהנדס בניין אחרי כמה שנים מרוויח 25-30 בקלות'), ask to see a pay slip, or call it a course sale; a few agree or ask 'איך מצטרפים לתכנית?'. The comment with the most likes in the sample argues that degrees have value (111 likes).
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: No replies from him in the sampled replies (they are between commenters).

conversion.cta_timing: caption only; the video has only the end card at about 76 s
conversion.offer: Membership of the entrepreneurs' club (the end card names it; price not shown)
conversion.benefit: Higher income than a salaried engineer, free time
conversion.proof: One member's testimony: 24,000 in the second month; 2.5 times an engineer's pay
conversion.objection_handling: The caption mentions that Matan has a degree himself and that dreams are what matter; no response to the pay doubts
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: none visible in the video; no link or keyword
conversion.cta_fits_content: partly: the testimony fits the club promo, but the video does not tell viewers how to join

rights_and_privacy: Only Matan appears with his own apartment; the guest is a voice on the phone (a tagged member, Yotam Bar, in the caption); the end card shows identifiable audience members. No third-party film.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a pay question with a surprising number in the first second, a candid phone call that feels like an authentic proof, and a personal redundancy story; the comment volume (155) shows it triggered a debate.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: 76 s on one static shot, claims with no proof and many commenters dispute the numbers; the 5-second end card has no concrete next step.

standout_moments.what: A pay question in the very first frame, with the anti-degree shirt visible, sets topic and stance at once.
Figures for the first and second month in the club (5,000 then 24,000) provide the escalation.
'אז אתה כבר מרוויח פי 2.5 מכל מהנדס שכיר' is the headline claim of the whole Reel.
